hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$root/cli/package.json" ] || exit 0; out=$(cd "$root/cli" && bun run typecheck 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; }
